title: The APT Foundation Champions Sustainability Onboard Travelmarvels European River Ships
author: Emma
body:
The APT Foundation Champions Sustainability Onboard Travelmarvels European River Ships, earning Green Award Status.

Travelmarvel’s latest fleet of Contemporary River Ships is leading the way in sustainable tourism practices, earning Green Award status. From ensuring catering staff are trained in food waste reduction, to removing single-use plastic from cruises, the APT Foundation and Travelmarvel are constantly looking for opportunities to reduce the companies carbon footprint and protect our environment for future generations. Read below the initiatives implemented on Travelmarvels European cruises.

Recycling and Reusing Plastic

Rather than opt for single-use products, we have invested in high quality cleaning materials, which can be washed and reused. Even something as simple as substituting single use plastic gloves for rubber cleaning gloves can dramatically reduce the amount of plastic destined landfill. Any plastics which cannot be repurposed onboard Travelmarvel ships are deposited at plastic recycling units rather than placed in general waste.

Removing One-Use Items

A small, but significant change in our fight to reduce waste has been removing all single-use plastic water bottles from tours. Fortunately, Travelmarvel guests have been all too happy to bring their own reusable water bottles, which can be used at the water stations placed throughout our River Ships and available 24/7.

We have also substituted small single-use wash products with refillable receptacles’, meaning product containers can be used for years on our cruises, rather than just one week.

Reducing Waste

An estimated 70% of food thrown away globally is perfectly usable, and at the APT Foundation, we want to ensure this troubling statistic isn’t representative of our food wastage on tour. The catering team onboard our European River Cruises have all participated in a recognised food waste saving program and have implemented best practices on tour to ensure wastage is kept to an absolute minimum. This includes ensuring our kitchens do not over produce and our team keep a diligent record of food usage to identify ways to further reduce waste.
